description: Defines the QuicEndpointBase class and related classes for simulating QUIC protocol endpoints in testing environments, including packet handling, connection management, and multiplexing.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase
classes.description: Represents a simulated QUIC connection endpoint for testing, capable of handling packets, managing connection state, and logging traces.

classes.name: QuicEndpointMultiplexer
classes.description: Handles multiplexing multiple QUIC endpoints on the same host in simulation.

methods.name: DropNextIncomingPacket
methods.description: Drops the next incoming packet to simulate packet loss.

methods.name: RecordTrace
methods.description: Enables logging of connection trace data.
